definitions.explanation: A specific matter, topic, or incident under discussion or consideration. Often used to refer back to something previously mentioned.

definitions.gloss: counter for cases, incidents, or items
definitions.explanation: A counter used for incidents, cases, complaints, applications, and similar discrete items or occurrences.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧{件|けん}⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{話|はな}しましょう→話す：00467_hanasu⟧。
⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{件|けん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧お⟦{電話|でんわ}しました→電話する：05652_denwasuru⟧。
examples.english: I'm calling regarding the matter in the email.

examples.japanese: ⟦{例|れい}→例：09932_rei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{件|けん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{部長|ぶちょう}→部長：01017_buchou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧お⟦{返事|へんじ}→返事：00844_henji⟧⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I'll get back to you about that matter after confirming with the department head.

examples.japanese: ⟦{苦情|くじょう}→苦情：00252_kujou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧{件|けん}⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
⟦{今月|こんげつ}→今月：00720_kongetsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{問|と}い{合|あ}わせ→問い合わせ：06131_toiawase⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{五十|ごじゅう}→五十：00930_gojuu⟧{件|けん}⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There were fifty inquiries this month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昨年|さくねん}→昨年：10433_sakunen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{交通|こうつう}{事故|じこ}→交通事故：21255_koutsuujiko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{約|やく}→約：09563_yaku⟧⟦{一万|いちまん}→一万：27599_ichiman⟧{件|けん}⟦{報告|ほうこく}→報告：03618_houkoku⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Approximately ten thousand traffic accidents were reported last year.

notes:
As a noun, {件|けん} is often used with demonstratives: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧{件|けん} (that matter), ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{件|けん} (this matter), ⟦{例|れい}→例：09932_rei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{件|けん} (that matter we discussed).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧{件|けん} (that matter)
- ⟦{例|れい}→例：09932_rei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{件|けん} (the matter in question)
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{件|けん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ (regarding the matter of...)
- ⟦{何|なん}→何〜：03100_nan⟧{件|けん} (how many cases)

COUNTING PATTERNS:
As a counter, {件|けん} has no sound changes. It counts:
- ⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧ (incidents), ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧ (accidents)
- ⟦{問|と}い{合|あ}わせ→問い合わせ：06131_toiawase⟧ (inquiries), ⟦{苦情|くじょう}→苦情：00252_kujou⟧ (complaints)
- ⟦{申|もう}し{込|こ}み→申し込み：03161_moushikomi⟧ (applications), ⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧ (contracts)
